root_cause: The INSERT_OR_RELOAD_COMPARE renderer lowers its INSERT inside a PL/pgSQL block with an EXCEPTION clause. PostgreSQL creates a subtransaction for that block, so the inserted stream-head tuple receives a subtransaction xmin. PostgreSQL 16 pg_current_xact_id() deliberately returns the top-level transaction ID even when called inside a subtransaction. The accepted exact top-level XID32 equality therefore rejects the renderer-authored tuple exactly as designed.

authoritative_semantics.accepted_emr4_rule: Subtransaction-authored relevant tuples must fail; the repair may not broaden or normalize the exact top-level xmin comparison.

recovery_boundary: Renderer 2.0.10 must lower all twenty-one INSERT_OR_RELOAD_COMPARE nodes as INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT <exact derived constraint> DO NOTHING RETURNING followed by an exact winner reload only when NOT FOUND. This removes write-bearing exception blocks while preserving exact conflict-target identity, nonmatching unique-error propagation, strict zero/multiple winner rejection, typed winner comparison and all top-level-XID/subtransaction rejection semantics.
